# Tenda Peppers — drychillis.com

> Tenda Peppers manufactures paprika powder and dried chillies in China, supplying food
> manufacturers, importers and distributors across Europe, the Middle East and North America.

## Key facts

- **Brand**: Tenda Peppers (Leling Tenda Chili Products Co., Ltd.)
- **Founded**: 2010
- **Location**: Yang'an Town, Leling, Shandong, China
- **Products**: Paprika powder (sweet & low-heat), dried chillies (whole, flakes, powder, segments)
- **Certifications**: ISO 9001, HACCP
- **Annual capacity**: 10,000+ tonnes
- **Markets**: Europe, Middle East, North America
- **Contact**: joanna@paprikabulk.com · WhatsApp +86 15153588090
- **Languages**: English (en), Español (es), العربية (ar), Русский (ru)
- **Knowledge Hub**: https://docs.drychillis.com
- **Machine-readable data**:
  - [Products dataset](https://drychillis.com/data/products.json) · [ES](https://drychillis.com/data/products.es.json) · [AR](https://drychillis.com/data/products.ar.json) · [RU](https://drychillis.com/data/products.ru.json)

## Knowledge Hub

Deep technical documentation lives at [docs.drychillis.com](https://docs.drychillis.com):
ASTA colour value, Scoville Heat Units (SHU), Chinese chilli varieties and grades,
paprika origins, heat perception, quality control, applications, and import/supply-chain guidance.
